risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, including segment sales expectations, earnings guidance, share repurchases, debt costs, and operating results. Risk factors include declining access-equipment demand, defense-spending pressure, weather and oil-and-gas exposure, and reliance on anticipated defense production and international vehicle sales. The overall tone is cautiously optimistic but contains forward-looking assumptions and some promotional market-position language.
